items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: What it really meant was, they had an expression called 'Joe, the Grinder.' ... But the short for that was Jody -- 'Jody got your old lady.'

ctx.x: Yeah. What it really meant was, they had an expression called "Joe, the Grinder." "Joe the Grinder's got your old lady!" But the short for that was Jody -- "Jody got your old lady." Just kiddin'!

So finally, this little guy comes in. He looks like he's probably 5'5", I guess. Small-built fellow, slight fellow. He's got on a uniform, and I don't know exactly what his position was, but he was an officer of some kind. He came in and said, "All right, you fellows. I want to welcome you to the Navy, so-and-so and so-and-so." Then he went on to break it down to what you were doing, and he said, "These lights go out at 8 o'clock, and you're supposed to go to sleep. There's going to be no activity in here…
